summary: Validated new PDF export button in Alert History panel and confirmed CSV regression. Empty-state disabled behavior verified; both buttons enabled after alerts logged; PDF & CSV downloads triggered with correct filename prefix/suffix; no console/page errors during PDF generation.
critical_code_review_comments: Scanner.jsx is large (900+ lines) — consider splitting AlertHistory panel and export utilities into separate modules for maintainability.
seed_data_creation: Alerts populated by arming threshold-50 on 1s timeframe for ~12s (5 threshold entries generated).
context_for_next_testing_agent: PDF export via jsPDF+autotable works. Filename pattern 'tradepulse-alerts-YYYY-MM-DD-HH-MM-SS.pdf'. Both CSV & PDF buttons share the same disabled state controlled by history length. Playwright expect_download works for both. History panel has a fixed inset-0 overlay wrapper — use data-testid='history-close' to close (not the toggle button underneath).
